#     def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.left = left

class Solution:
    def correctBinaryTree(self, root: TreeNode) -> TreeNode:
        def dfs(root):
            if root is None or root.right in vis:
                return None
            vis.add(root)
            root.right = dfs(root.right)
            root.left = dfs(root.left)
            return root

        vis = set()
        return dfs(root)
